# Encouragement ribbons

`great-streak.png` is the green P1 GREAT ribbon supplied by the user, extracted from its cream background with built-in imagegen. It appears after every three consecutive correct target submissions.

`great-complete.png` is the red P2 GREAT ribbon supplied by the user, extracted in the same way. It appears after the last target lands and before settlement when the shared three-word interval allows it.

Both files are transparent 2172×724 PNGs. Runtime SVG viewBoxes crop empty padding without modifying the delivered assets. The host is 72% of the game viewport width and is centered in the gap above the board. Full edit prompts and source filenames are in `generation.json`.
